description: This file contains the definition of the IReminderService interface, which manages reminder scheduling, registration, unregistration, and retrieval for grains in Orleans.

classes.name: IReminderService
classes.description: Interface for managing reminders, providing methods to start, stop, register, unregister, and retrieve reminders.

methods.name: RegisterOrUpdateReminder
methods.description: Registers a new reminder or updates an existing one for a specific grain.

methods.name: GetReminder
methods.description: Retrieves a particular reminder for a grain based on name.

methods.name: GetReminders
methods.description: Retrieves all reminders registered for a specific grain.
